declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun
declarations.source_header: def chopRun : (d : Nat) → List α → Measured (List (List α)) Nat
declarations.statement_assessment: Actual positive/nonempty recursion evaluates separate measured take and drop, recurses on the returned drop value, and adds one entry. Size zero and empty each cost one; list length decreases independently of any cost or correctness premise.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_zero
declarations.source_header: theorem chopRun_zero (xs : List α) : chopRun 0 xs = ([], 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: Size zero returns an empty list for every input with exactly one entry, matching the source convention.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_nil
declarations.source_header: theorem chopRun_nil (d : Nat) : chopRun d ([] : List α) = ([], 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: Empty input costs one at every group size, including zero and uninhabited payload types.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_eq_cons
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_eq_cons (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    chopRun d xs =
      (xs.take d :: (chopRun d (xs.drop d)).1,
        (ListCalls.takeRun d xs).2 + (ListCalls.dropRun d xs).2 +
          (chopRun d (xs.drop d)).2 + 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: With positive size and nonempty input, the returned head is take d and the tail is the recursive execution on drop d; both primitive counts and one source entry are included.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_value
declarations.source_header: theorem chopRun_value (d : Nat) (xs : List α) : (chopRun d xs).1 = chop d xs
declarations.statement_assessment: For every natural size and arbitrary payload list, returned chunks equal the existing splitLengths value adapter. Recursive proof uses strictly shorter drops, not an assumed cost or value law.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_cost (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (chopRun d xs).2 = 2 * xs.length + 3 * (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: For positive d and n input occurrences, the exact cost is 2*n+3*ceil(n/d)+1. Both traversals sum to 2*n; two primitive base entries plus one chopping entry occur per chunk; the final empty call contributes one.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_exact (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) :
    chopRun d xs = (chop d xs, 2 * xs.length + 3 * (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) + 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: Conjoins the independently established actual value and exact positive-size cost; it does not define an execution by a specification-cost pair.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_cost_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_cost_bound (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chopRun d xs).2 ≤ 5 * xs.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: The uniform bound 5*n+1 uses ceil(n/d)≤n for positive d and handles size zero separately; it imposes no order or distinctness requirement.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_one_cost
declarations.source_header: theorem chopRun_one_cost (xs : List α) : (chopRun 1 xs).2 = 5 * xs.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: Singleton groups attain the uniform source count 5*n+1, including the empty base.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_length (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chopRun d xs).1.length = xs.length ⌈/⌉ d
declarations.statement_assessment: Returned chunk count is the existing natural ceiling n ceilDiv d, including the zero-size convention.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_mem_ne_nil
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_mem_ne_nil (d : Nat) (xs ys : List α)
    (hy : ys ∈ (chopRun d xs).1) : ys ≠ []
declarations.statement_assessment: Only membership in an actually returned chunk list is required to prove that a reached chunk is nonempty; this supplies the later callback domain.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_mem_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_mem_length (d : Nat) (xs ys : List α)
    (hy : ys ∈ (chopRun d xs).1) : ys.length ≤ d
declarations.statement_assessment: Each reached chunk has length at most d, retaining the possibly short final chunk.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.Chunks.chopRun_flatten
declarations.source_header:
theorem chopRun_flatten (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (chopRun d xs).1.flatten = xs
declarations.statement_assessment: Positive group size is necessary for flattening the returned chunks to recover every original occurrence; no order or no-duplicate premise is introduced.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun
declarations.source_header: def slowMedianValueRun (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) : Measured α Nat
declarations.statement_assessment: The adapter evaluates slowMedianRun once, extracts the payload of its actual some branch, and retains its actual count. Nonemptiness makes none impossible; no inhabitant, default value, cleanup traversal, or separately computed specification payload is used.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_of_some
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_of_some (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) (a : α)
    (ha : (slowMedianRun xs).1 = some a) :
    slowMedianValueRun xs hx = (a, (slowMedianRun xs).2)
declarations.statement_assessment: Given the actual run value some a, extraction returns exactly a and the same run count. This is an operational correspondence, not a correctness or cost premise used to define the run.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_of_run
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_of_run (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) (a : α) (c : Nat)
    (h : slowMedianRun xs = (some a, c)) : slowMedianValueRun xs hx = (a, c)
declarations.statement_assessment: A concrete exact optional run transports both value and cost to the payload adapter, enabling reuse of the independently checked finite auxiliary examples.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_some
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_some (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    some (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).1 = (slowMedianRun xs).1
declarations.statement_assessment: Reinserting the option constructor recovers the actual underlying optional run value for every nonempty input.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_cost (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).2 = (slowMedianRun xs).2
declarations.statement_assessment: The payload adapter preserves the underlying measured cost without adding a wrapper charge under the declared source tariff.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_ranked
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_ranked (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    RankedAt xs ((xs.length - 1) / 2) (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).1
declarations.statement_assessment: The actual returned payload has the lower occurrence rank (n-1)/2; arbitrary duplicates are retained.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_mem
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_mem (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).1 ∈ xs
declarations.statement_assessment: The actual payload occurs in its input. This will support a noncircular termination certificate for nested selection.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_value (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).1 = lowerMedianValue xs hx
declarations.statement_assessment: Occurrence-rank uniqueness proves correspondence with the existing lowerMedianValue specification after executing the measured algorithm.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.slowMedianValueRun_small_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem slowMedianValueRun_small_bound (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ [])
    (hn : xs.length ≤ 5) : (slowMedianValueRun xs hx).2 ≤ 47
declarations.statement_assessment: For every nonempty list of at most five occurrences, the retained source count is at most 47, including short final chunks.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun
declarations.source_header:
def mapSlowMedianRun (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) : Measured (List α) Nat
declarations.statement_assessment: The existing measured map executes the actual payload callback once per reached chunk occurrence. attach is a proof-domain adapter under the source call model; this is not a Lean runtime/allocation bound.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_value (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).1 =
      xss.attach.map (fun ys => lowerMedianValue ys.val (hne ys.val ys.property))
declarations.statement_assessment: The returned list agrees occurrence by occurrence with mapping the existing mathematical lower median over proof-carrying nonempty chunks.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_some_values
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_some_values (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).1.map some = xss.map (fun ys => (slowMedianRun ys).1)
declarations.statement_assessment: Mapping some over the result observes exactly the underlying optional callback values. The theorem introduces no additional execution pass or cost claim.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_length (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) : (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).1.length = xss.length
declarations.statement_assessment: One payload is returned for every input chunk occurrence. No filter or deduplication is hidden in the implementation.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_cost (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).2 =
      (xss.map (fun ys => (slowMedianRun ys).2)).sum + xss.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: The exact cost is the sum of actual slowMedianRun costs plus m+1 map entries; it does not assume constant callback work.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_bound (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) (d : Nat)
    (hlen : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys.length ≤ d) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).2 ≤ (d ^ 2 + 4 * d + 3) * xss.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: If every reached chunk has length at most d, actual cost is at most (d^2+4*d+3)*m+1. The bound follows from actual callback costs and monotonicity of the polynomial on naturals.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_small_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_small_bound (xss : List (List α))
    (hne : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys ≠ []) (hlen : ∀ ys ∈ xss, ys.length ≤ 5) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun xss hne).2 ≤ 48 * xss.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: The general group bound specializes to 48*m+1 for nonempty chunks of size at most five.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.mapSlowMedianRun_chop_five_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem mapSlowMedianRun_chop_five_bound (xs : List α) :
    (mapSlowMedianRun (chop 5 xs) (chop_mem_ne_nil 5 xs)).2 ≤ 10 * xs.length + 48
declarations.statement_assessment: For the actual size-five chunk list, natural-ceiling arithmetic gives the source bound 10*n+48, including empty input and partial final groups.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun
declarations.source_header: def chunkMediansRun (d : Nat) (xs : List α) : Measured (List α) Nat
declarations.statement_assessment: The nonrecursive composition executes actual chopping once and actual median mapping on its returned chunks. The total is the sum of these actual observations, with no extra wrapper entry.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_value (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).1 = chunkMedians d xs
declarations.statement_assessment: The actual prepared payload list agrees with the already specified chunkMedians for every d and xs; this does not substitute a specification computation for execution.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_some_values
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_some_values (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).1.map some = (chop d xs).map (fun ys => (slowMedianRun ys).1)
declarations.statement_assessment: An optional observation of the actual prepared payloads connects each to the underlying measured slow median on the corresponding source chunk.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_cost_split
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_cost_split (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).2 = (Resources.Chunks.chopRun d xs).2 +
      (mapSlowMedianRun (chop d xs) (chop_mem_ne_nil d xs)).2
declarations.statement_assessment: Exact total count is actual chopping plus actual map on the corresponding returned/source chunks, with proof irrelevance only in domain certificates.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_cost
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_cost (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).2 = (Resources.Chunks.chopRun d xs).2 +
      ((chop d xs).map (fun ys => (slowMedianRun ys).2)).sum + (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: For every size, the total equals actual chopping plus the callback sum plus ceil(n/d)+1 map calls.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_cost_positive
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_cost_positive (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).2 = 2 * xs.length + 4 * (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) +
      ((chop d xs).map (fun ys => (slowMedianRun ys).2)).sum + 2
declarations.statement_assessment: For positive d, the closed expression 2*n+4*ceil(n/d)+sum(actual callback costs)+2 accounts for both primitive traversals and both terminal bases.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_length
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_length (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).1.length = xs.length ⌈/⌉ d
declarations.statement_assessment: The actual prepared list has precisely ceil(n/d) entries, rather than a floor or a deduplicated count.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_eq_nil_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_eq_nil_iff (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).1 = [] ↔ d = 0 ∨ xs = []
declarations.statement_assessment: The actual prepared list is empty exactly when size is zero or input is empty; neither requires an arbitrary payload inhabitant.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_mem
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_mem (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (a : α)
    (ha : a ∈ (chunkMediansRun d xs).1) : a ∈ xs
declarations.statement_assessment: Every prepared payload belongs to the original input, through its reached chunk; this is a future nested-selector membership bridge.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_bound (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun d xs).2 ≤
      5 * xs.length + (d ^ 2 + 4 * d + 3) * (xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) + 2
declarations.statement_assessment: The bound retains d for generalized grouping: 5*n+(d^2+4*d+3)*ceil(n/d)+2. It covers size zero explicitly through the actual source execution.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionMedians.chunkMediansRun_five_bound
declarations.source_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_five_bound (xs : List α) :
    (chunkMediansRun 5 xs).2 ≤ 15 * xs.length + 49
declarations.statement_assessment: The book preparation bound 15*n+49 combines actual chop ≤5*n+1 and actual map ≤10*n+48; later full selector toll still requires its own execution proof.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.empty_payload
declarations.source_header: theorem empty_payload (d : Nat) : chopRun d ([] : List (Fin 0)) = ([], 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: For every d, the empty list of Fin 0 has exact result ([],1), showing no payload inhabitant is required.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.zero_size
declarations.source_header: theorem zero_size : chopRun 0 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat) = ([], 1)
declarations.statement_assessment: For nonempty [7,2,4], d=0 returns ([],1) without traversing or selecting a value.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.singleton_chunks
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_chunks :
    chopRun 1 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat) = ([[7], [2], [4]], 16)
declarations.statement_assessment: For d=1 and [7,2,4], independently expected chunks [[7],[2],[4]] and cost16 exercise the tight uniform bound.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.short_final_chunk
declarations.source_header:
theorem short_final_chunk :
    chopRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat) = ([[7, 2], [4]], 13)
declarations.statement_assessment: For d=2 and [7,2,4], independently expected [[7,2],[4]] and cost13 retain the singleton final group.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.oversized_group
declarations.source_header:
theorem oversized_group :
    chopRun 10 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat) = ([[7, 2, 4]], 10)
declarations.statement_assessment: For d=10 and [7,2,4], independently expected single original chunk and cost10 test d greater than input length.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.first_recursive_size
declarations.statement_assessment: For d=5 and range21, four full chunks plus [20] cost58; this is the first input length above the book cutoff, not yet an implemented nested selector.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.both_traversals_are_charged
declarations.source_header:
theorem both_traversals_are_charged :
    (Resources.ListCalls.takeRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat)).2 = 3 ∧
      (Resources.ListCalls.dropRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat)).2 = 3 ∧
      (chopRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat)).2 = 13
declarations.statement_assessment: At the d=2 first step, take and drop each cost3 while the complete chopping costs13. The case consumes their actual public measured laws.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.fused_first_step_is_not_source_count
declarations.source_header:
theorem fused_first_step_is_not_source_count :
    (Resources.SymmetricCosts.splitRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat)).2 +
        (chopRun 2 ([4] : List Nat)).2 + 1 = 10 ∧
      (chopRun 2 ([7, 2, 4] : List Nat)).2 ≠ 10
declarations.statement_assessment: Precisely replacing only the first pair by one split gives3+6+1=10, while source chopping costs13. It is not a claim that a fully fused alternative costs10.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.no_occurrence_is_lost
declarations.source_header:
theorem no_occurrence_is_lost {α : Type u} (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (chopRun d xs).1.flatten = xs
declarations.statement_assessment: The generic positive-size flatten correspondence applies to all payload types and lists, including duplicates.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.reached_chunks_are_valid
declarations.source_header:
theorem reached_chunks_are_valid {α : Type u} (d : Nat) (xs ys : List α)
    (hy : ys ∈ (chopRun d xs).1) : ys ≠ [] ∧ ys.length ≤ d
declarations.statement_assessment: A chunk reached by the actual run simultaneously satisfies nonemptiness and the size cap needed by the median-map callback.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.ChunkCalls.arbitrary_group_budget
declarations.source_header:
theorem arbitrary_group_budget {α : Type u} (d : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (chopRun d xs).2 ≤ 5 * xs.length + 1
declarations.statement_assessment: The uniform source budget is applied without order or positive-size assumptions; zero and empty cases remain covered.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionMedians.lower_even_payload
declarations.source_header:
theorem lower_even_payload :
    slowMedianValueRun ([7, 2] : List Nat) (by decide) = (2, 10)
declarations.statement_assessment: The existing checked optional run on [7,2] transports to payload2 and cost10; this selects the lower occurrence for an even-sized chunk.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionMedians.duplicate_payload
declarations.source_header:
theorem duplicate_payload :
    slowMedianValueRun ([4, 4] : List Nat) (by decide) = (4, 9)
declarations.statement_assessment: The existing checked [4,4] run transports to payload4 and cost9, retaining occurrence semantics.
declarations.status: Source-level statement assessment complete; elaboration and actual explicit type assessment remain pending root.

declarations.name: Examples.SelectionMedians.payload_rank_and_budget
declarations.source_header:
